This '''girl''' was a [[Lethan/Legends|Lethan]] [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]] girl who lived on in the city of [[Nabat/Legends|Nabat]] on [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. She was playing with her friends [[Numa/Legends|Numa]] and [[Lubo (Twi'lek)|Lubo]] shortly before the forces of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] invaded her home around [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]].
